ligand_reaction_diffusion.section: Explicit reaction-diffusion kinetics for the three diffusible ligands acting upstream of posterior marginal-ring Myosin-II phosphorylation (Pass 2 remediation item 2)

equations.wnt8c: dW/dt = D_W nabla^2 W + s_W S_post(x) - k_W W
equations.nodal: dN/dt = D_N nabla^2 N + s_N H(W; K_W) (1 + f_N H(N; K_N)) - k_N N
equations.fgf8: dF/dt = D_F nabla^2 F + s_F H(N; K_N) - k_F F
equations.myosin_phosphorylation: P(x,t) = rho_ROCK * H(N_eff; K_N) * (0.35 + 0.65 H(F_eff; K_F)),  N_eff = a_ALK * N (SB431542 -> a_ALK = 0),  F_eff = a_FGFR * F (SU5402 -> a_FGFR = 0)
equations.cable_source: Dm/Dt gains the term + alpha_P * P(x,t) * ring(r) * (1 - m / m_sat)
equations.steady_decay_length: lambda = sqrt(D / k) for a localized source with linear clearance (Yu et al. 2009 source-sink mechanism)

parameters.D_fgf8_source: yu2009 (free FGF8-EGFP diffusion coefficient in zebrafish blastula extracellular space, FCS)
parameters.fgf8_half_life_source: ASSUMED order-of-magnitude clearance (Yu et al. 2009 report rapid endocytic clearance; the exact chick value is not sourced) — flagged for Pass 4
parameters.D_wnt8c_source: ASSUMED short-range lipid-modified Wnt diffusivity (order 1 um^2/s); not sourced for Wnt8c — flagged for Pass 4
parameters.units_note: D converted to mm^2/h (x 3.6e-3); half-lives converted to first-order rates k = ln2 / t_half in h^-1

derived_decay_lengths_um.note: lambda = sqrt(D/k); values rounded. FGF8 is the only ligand whose decay length is resolvable on the 40 um grid (>= 9 cells).

regime_receptor_activity.note: SU5402 blocks FGFR tyrosine kinase; SB431542 blocks ALK4/5/7 (Nodal/Activin/TGF-beta type I receptors); Y-27632 blocks ROCK (rho_ROCK = rock_activity); ectopic Vg1/Wnt adds a second anterior marginal Wnt source.

apical_basal_wedging_emt.section: Reduced trans-epithelial column model coupling 3D apical-basal cell wedging and basement-membrane remodeling to the 2D planar Stokes sink (Pass 2 remediation item 1). This is NOT a 3D FEM: each planar grid point carries one columnar cell (apical area a, basal area b, height h, basement-membrane integrity B).

equations.apical_constriction: da/dt = -k_con * rho_ROCK * max(m - m_c, 0) * a + k_rel * (1 - a)   (supra-threshold Myosin-II cables constrict the apex)
equations.basal_area: b = 1 + chi_b * (1 - a) * B   (basal expansion while the basement membrane is intact)
equations.volume_conservation: h = 2 V0 / (a + b),  V0 = h0 (a0 + b0) / 2 with a0 = b0 = 1 so h = 2 h0 / (a + b)
equations.basement_membrane: dB/dt = -k_bm * H(N_eff; K_N) * (0.5 + 0.5 H(F_eff; K_F)) * Wdg * B   (RhoA/microtubule loss + MMP-mediated breakdown, Nakaya et al. 2008)
equations.ingression_rate: I = k_ing * Wdg * (1 - B)   [h^-1]  (self-amplifying individual cell ingression, Voiculescu et al. 2014)
equations.planar_sink_coupling: nabla . v_sink = -I,  v_sink = -nabla phi,  nabla^2 phi = I  (solved spectrally); replaces the Pass 2 prescribed Gaussian midline sink

parameters.h0_source: ASSUMED lateral epiblast columnar height at HH1-HH2 (order 20-30 um); flagged for Pass 4

reference_values.streak_apical_area_reduction_source: rozbicki2015 (streak-forming cells apically constrict to roughly half the apical area of lateral epiblast cells; approximate reading of Fig. 2-3) — flagged approximate
reference_values.streak_thickening_source: DERIVED from the constant-volume column with the Rozbicki et al. (2015) ~2x apical constriction (a -> 0.5) and basal area relaxing to 1 after basement-membrane loss: h/h0 = 2/(0.5 + 1) = 1.33. Not an independently measured chick value — flagged for Pass 4
reference_values.sb431542_source: voiculescu2014 (SB-431542 Nodal/ALK block abolishes mesendoderm ingression)
reference_values.bm_source: nakaya2008 (basement membrane breakdown is restricted to the primitive streak midline)
reference_values.streak_bm_breakdown_area_fraction_source: Footprint of a 1.18 mm x 0.28 mm HH3 streak over the pi R^2 (R = 1.15 mm) area pellucida = 0.08 (Saadaoui et al. 2020 streak dimensions; Nakaya et al. 2008 BM breakdown restricted to the streak) — approximate, flagged
